title: Giving AI a “crystal clear” view of the materials world
hook_text: AI now designs new crystal materials
script:
MIT researchers just launched a multimodal AI that finds optimal crystalline materials for specific uses.
It pairs 3D atomic structures with natural language to identify materials based on your text descriptions.
Professor Ju Li led the team to build this bridge between human language and atomic geometry.
The model solves a massive hurdle in material science by linking text to complex 3D data.
This research was just published in the journal Nature Communications.
It allows labs to search for materials using simple concepts instead of complex mathematical formulas.
Would you use AI to invent your next material?
